info.title: Suno API Plus Next
info.description: Unofficial self-hosted Suno API gateway with account affinity, Studio workflows, Advanced Split, Fast Upload and OpenAI-compatible routes.

get.description: Returns the OpenAI-compatible model catalog. When API key authentication is enabled, send Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (or x-api-key). Use the returned public id in generation requests. Actual availability depends on the selected Suno account plan and upstream permissions.

metadata.label: Suno Music (Latest)
metadata.description: Recommended OpenAI-compatible alias for the latest Suno music model.

metadata.label: Suno V5.5
metadata.description: Latest Suno model with improved expression and personalization.

get.summary: Get active credit and multiplier billing settings.
get.description: Returns persisted settings and calculated costs. API key authentication is required when enabled for /v1/*. Defaults: CNY 120 / 2500 credits, 10 credits and 2 songs per request, multiplier 1, and CNY 1 per USD balance unit. Results: CNY 0.048 per credit, CNY 0.48 per request, and CNY 0.24 per song.

200.description: Active billing settings and calculated summary.

500.description: Billing settings could not be loaded.

get.summary: Declare the upstream rate multiplier to Sub2API.
get.description: Sub2API compatibility probe. It exposes the active rateMultiplier using the schema required by Sub2API. This declaration does not change the per-request generation charge.

500.description: Billing multiplier could not be loaded.

get.summary: Get billing settings for the admin panel.
get.description: Requires a valid suno_admin_session cookie created by the admin login flow.

200.description: Active billing settings and calculated summary.

500.description: Billing settings could not be loaded.

put.description: Persists positive numeric settings to billing-settings.json beside ACCOUNT_DATA_PATH and applies them immediately without a restart. Requires a valid suno_admin_session cookie.

400.description: A supplied setting is not a positive finite number.

500.description: Billing settings could not be saved.

get.summary: Get global generation concurrency settings and live capacity.
get.description: Requires a valid suno_admin_session cookie. The default global limit is 4 concurrent generation requests.

200.description: Current settings, active request count, and available slots.

500.description: Concurrency settings could not be loaded.

put.summary: Update the global generation concurrency limit.
put.description: Accepts maxConcurrentRequests from 1 to 100 and applies the new limit immediately. Requires a valid suno_admin_session cookie.

400.description: maxConcurrentRequests is not an integer from 1 to 100.

500.description: Concurrency settings could not be saved.

post.summary: Submit a generation request from the admin panel.
Generate music using the OpenAI Responses format.

post.description:
It will automatically fill in the lyrics.

2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.

`wait_audio` can be set to API mode:

• By default, it is set to `false`, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.

• If set to `true`, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously. The lyrics depict the sorrow of people after the war.

model.description: Public Suno model ID. Defaults to suno-music (currently Suno V5.5 / chirp-fenix). Raw chirp-* identifiers remain pass-through compatible. Availability depends on the account plan and upstream permissions.

voice_id.description: Optional public Suno +Voice UUID or https://suno.com/voice/<id> URL. Private Voices and make_instrumental=true are rejected.

account_affinity.description: Opaque signed value selecting the generation target account. A public Voice may be owned by a different account.

wait_audio.description: Whether to wait for music generation, default is false, directly return audio task information; set to true, will wait for up to 100s until the audio is generated.

post.summary: Generate audio based on Prompt - OpenAI API format compatibility.
post.description:
Convert the `/api/generate` API to be compatible with the OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` API format. 

Generally used in OpenAI compatible clients.

prompt.example: A popular heavy metal song about war, sung by a deep-voiced male singer, slowly and melodiously. The lyrics depict the sorrow of people after the war.

data.description: Text description for music, with details like title, album cover, lyrics, and more.

post.summary: Upload audio for a later Cover request
post.description: Measures duration with server-side FFprobe. Files <=30.000s use direct upload; files >30.000s use the synchronous Studio fast uploader (1800s default) with no direct fallback. Send a stable Idempotency-Key for fast uploads.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable content-and-metadata operation key. Completed fast uploads replay their result; running keys return 409; submission_unknown keys never auto-retry. Use /api/upload_audio/reconcile for a read-only status check; an explicitly authorized replay must use a new key.

prompt.description: Optional source description or lyrics metadata.

200.description: Direct upload or completed Studio project clip.

portable_clip.description: true for Studio-rendered clips that were verified for cross-account lookup, Cover and Extend. This is not Suno is_public.

account_affinity.description: Opaque signed value; do not modify it. It is not a Cookie or bearer credential.

409.description: Idempotency conflict/in progress, duplicate catalog audio, or bound account unavailable.

422.description: Duration could not be determined or Suno definitively rejected the upload.

429.description: Fast uploader or account pool is busy; submission_state is not_submitted.

502.description: A Studio project exists but the final clip is uncertain; submission_state is submission_unknown and replay is blocked.

504.description: Fast upload timed out; submission_state reports whether a project was observed.

post.summary: Generate a Cover from a source clip
post.description: Generates two Cover clips. Any source created by /api/upload_audio (including portable Studio fast uploads) must use the returned account_affinity; cross-account Cover is not supported upstream.

account_affinity.description: Owning account affinity returned by /api/upload_audio. Required for uploaded sources; do not replace it with another account. A public Voice may belong to a different account.

source_upload.description: Internal routing marker used by the local client to fail closed when an uploaded source has no affinity.

prompt.description: Lyrics; lyrics takes precedence when both fields are supplied.

voice_id.description: Optional public Suno +Voice UUID or https://suno.com/voice/<id> URL. Private Voices are rejected.

persona_id.description: Legacy persona id. It is treated as a Voice when persona_model is voice_persona.

200.description: Two submitted or completed Cover clips.

400.description: Missing clip id or invalid account-affinity token.

409.description: The source-owning account is temporarily unavailable.

post.description:
The custom mode enables users to provide additional details about the music, such as music genre, lyrics, and more.

 2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits. 

 `wait_audio` can be set to API mode:

• By default, it is set to false, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.

• If set to true, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents.

prompt.description: Detailed prompt, including information such as music lyrics.
prompt.example:
[Verse 1]
Cruel flames of war engulf this land
Battlefields filled with death and dread
Innocent souls in darkness, they rest
My heart trembles in this silent test

[Verse 2]
People weep for loved ones lost
Battered bodies bear the cost
Seeking peace and hope once known
Our grief transforms to hearts of stone

[Chorus]
Silent battlegrounds, no birds' song
Shadows of war, where we don't belong
May flowers of peace bloom in this place
Let's guard this precious dream with grace

[Bridge]
Through the ashes, we will rise
Hand in hand, towards peaceful skies
No more sorrow, no more pain
Together, we'll break these chains

[Chorus]
Silent battlegrounds, no birds' song
Shadows of war, where we don't belong
May flowers of peace bloom in this place
Let's guard this precious dream with grace

[Outro]
In unity, our strength will grow
A brighter future, we'll soon know
From the ruins, hope will spring
A new dawn, we'll together bring

get.summary: Resolve and validate one public Suno +Voice
get.description: Only public persona_type=vox Voices are supported. Account-private Voice listing is intentionally unavailable. The optional account_affinity selects the account that must be able to use this public Voice; a public Voice may be owned by a different account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Public Voice UUID or https://suno.com/voice/<id> URL.

parameters.name: account_affinity
parameters.description: Opaque generation-target affinity returned by a prior /api/voices or /api/upload_audio call.

200.description: Validated public Voice and generation-target affinity.

account_affinity.description: Opaque generation-target affinity; return it with generation or deterministic polling.

400.description: Missing/invalid id, private Voice, non-Voice persona, or invalid account-affinity token.

409.description: The affinity-bound account is temporarily unavailable.
